title: Permutation construction on joined cube blocks
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $g$ map that cube to $\{\pm1\}$. For any $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the function on the joined blocks $(x,y)$ defined by the permutation construction has value
\[(-1)^{\langle x,\pi(y)\rangle}\,g(y),\]
where the inner product is taken in $\mathbb F_2$ and the exponent is interpreted as the associated real sign.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the $n$-dimensional $\mathbb F_2$ cube
$x,y$ are elements of the $n$-dimensional $\mathbb F_2$ cube
